categories.main_business_segments: Suzhou SLAC Precision Equipment Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the design, manufacturing, and assembly of high-speed metal packaging production equipment including easy-open can lids and cans. The company has expanded into the new energy sector, focusing on intelligent production lines and structural parts for new energy vehicle battery shells. Additional segments include intelligent inspection equipment, digital can printing mini-lines, and photovoltaic power generation.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as ultra-thin metal forming (DWI technology), precision continuous progressive die stamping, high-speed synchronized motion mechanisms, and automated control systems. It has developed proprietary high-speed production lines for easy-open lids and cans, including a world-leading six-channel combined lid production system and a patented bi-directional double-stroke stretching machine. For battery shells, it employs high-speed automated production lines with superior consistency and efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global and domestic metal packaging manufacturers such as Ball, Crown, Ardagh, and major Chinese packaging firms like COFCO Packaging and Baosteel Packaging. In the new energy battery shell segment, customers are top-tier battery manufacturers including CATL, EVE Energy, Ganfeng Lithium, and Ruipu Lanjun. The end markets served are beverage and food packaging, new energy vehicles, energy storage, and related industrial sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Suzhou, Changzhou, Yibin, and other locations. It also has subsidiaries and operations in the United States, Italy, the United Kingdom, and Hong Kong, serving international markets including Southeast Asia, Europe, and the Americas.
categories.supply_chain_position: Suzhou SLAC functions mainly as a midstream and upstream equipment manufacturer and supplier within the metal packaging and new energy battery supply chains. It provides specialized production equipment and structural components to downstream packaging producers and battery manufacturers, enabling their manufacturing processes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation in high-speed metal forming and automation, focusing on enhancing production efficiency, product consistency, and cost reduction. R&D efforts target advanced battery shell production lines, intelligent manufacturing platforms integrating AI and industrial internet technologies, and expansion into robotics components such as harmonic reducers for humanoid robots. It also emphasizes digital printing technologies and smart inspection systems.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of customized high-speed production equipment, battery shell products, and related services including system upgrades and technical support. The company operates on a direct sales model supplemented by agency sales, with prepayments and milestone payments tied to project delivery and acceptance. It also earns income from photovoltaic power generation and financial investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the metal packaging equipment sector, SLAC competes with established international leaders such as STOLLE, DRT, BELVAC, and CMB Engineering. It has broken foreign monopolies in China and holds a leading domestic position with advanced technology and a broad product portfolio. In the new energy battery shell market, it is a newer entrant but rapidly growing, competing with established battery component manufacturers and leveraging its technological advantages to gain market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.51 billion, with a decline of 8.45% compared to the previous year, primarily due to cyclical downturns in traditional equipment sales. The new energy battery shell segment grew by over 51%, becoming the dominant revenue contributor at 66% of total sales. The company experienced a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB -137 million, reflecting increased costs and competitive pressures. Total assets reached RMB 5.05 billion, showing a 15.75% increase year-over-year.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: SLAC emphasizes its technological leadership in ultra-high-speed, high-precision metal forming equipment with proprietary patents and innovations that enhance production speed and product quality. Its integrated solutions combine hardware, software, and services, offering customers improved efficiency, reduced labor costs, and superior product consistency. The company’s digital printing and smart inspection capabilities provide unique customization and quality assurance advantages. In the battery shell market, its advanced automated lines deliver higher consistency and lower costs, supporting customers’ scale and quality demands.
